notes.title: Deadly Survival - PreAlpha 0 - A clean slate
notes.content:
Start of the development diary.

SGK is taken as the basis for the game, and then everything starts to be developed.

[b]that is already in the game as of today:[/b]
 - Forest.
 - Character.
 - The need for food and water
 - Health and stamina
 - The possibility of dying
 - UI.
 - Inventory.
 - Multiplayer game
